promises.label: FY26 EBIT margin
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: This reported EBIT margin is what we are targeting, that we will touch 14% in FY’26?

promises.label: EBIT margin threshold
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: If we do hit the 14% reported EBIT margin plan for the year, we will, at a minimum, irrespective of the changes in the macros, commit ourselves to delivering on that as the minimum threshold going forward in the years to come.

promises.label: Free cash flow to PAT
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: we believe on a sustained basis, you should expect free cash flow to PAT at around 70% to 80% going forward.

promises.label: Ninth consecutive year of robust growth
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: We remain committed, strongly committed, to turning in the ninth consecutive year of robust growth, despite the uncertain macros swirling around our industry.

promises.label: Healthcare book of business
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: One is healthcare, where we think that by the end of this year, we will have a book of business of almost $100 million.

promises.label: Public sector outside India run rate
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: And the second is public sector outside India, which is a book of business that has already crossed 150 odd million dollars and we think that in the coming quarters, we should start nudging the 200 million dollar run rate on the vertical as well.

promises.label: Cigniti acquisition completion
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: We expect that to be getting completed by either December, Jan timeframe.

promises.label: FY26 EBIT margin minimum
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: Ankur, once we hit 14% EBIT, if we manage to hit it this year, we will plan to at a minimum clip along at 14% EBIT, but our primary aim will be to make sure that we prioritize growth over any further EBIT improvement.

promises.label: Free cash flow to PAT ratio
promises.speaker: Saurabh Goel
promises.quote: So, the focus will be to maintain FCF to PAT of 80 odd percent, 75 to 80 odd percent.

promises.label: Effective date of Cigniti merger

promises.quote: effective date of the merger is 1st April 2025.

promises.label: Sustained and robust growth
promises.speaker: Sudhir Singh
promises.quote: intent, as always, and exemplified by our results over the last nine years, continues to be that over the next two to three years and beyond, we will continue to turn in sustained and robust growth.
